ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p32/r7.claim: The Qur’an’s fleeing audience has an indicated underlying motive; the Prophet should ignore them and only remind them, while benefit is reserved for those God’s laws make receptive.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r1.claim: Islahi wonders why disbelievers reject the Reminder despite receiving advance warning, a revealed Book, and a messenger from God.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r1.anchor: They should have shown gratitude to the Almighty for being reminded in advance of the Day of reward and punishment.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r2.claim: The word mu'ridin is an accusative of state deriving from the genitive pronoun in lahum, a common Arabic construction.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p58/r2.anchor: is an accusative of state from the genitive pronoun in

THALABI:v10p77#2/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p77#2/r4.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p77#2/r4.claim: The phrase about turning away from the reminder is an accusative circumstantial construction; another parse treats them as having become heedless of it.
THALABI:v10p77#2/r4.anchor: فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين نصب على الحال، وقيل: صاروا معرضين

ELMALILI:74:32-56#2/r13.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:74:32-56#2/r13.speaker: author
ELMALILI:74:32-56#2/r13.claim: Turning away from the Qurʾānic reminder cannot help deniers escape the fate it warns about.
ELMALILI:74:32-56#2/r13.anchor: Bu Kur’an’dan yüz çevirmekte, o yakīni ihtar ile edilen nasihatten kaçınmalarında kendileri için bir fayda mı var?

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r9.claim: The reminder from which they turn away may mean the Qur'an, or reminder in its broader sense.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r9.anchor: { فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين } أي معرضين عن التذكرة يعني القرآن، أو ما يعمه

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:41-49/r10.claim: The word معرضين is a circumstantial expression.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r9.claim: The dialogue is recounted as a moral lesson and reminder for its listeners.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r9.anchor: ولتكون حكاية ذلك موعظة للسامعين وذكرى للذاكرين

BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r10.claim: The believers ask to learn the damned person’s condition, not to seek intercession for them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r10.anchor: لا يظن به التعريض للشفاعة إلا السؤال منهم عن أنفسهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r11.claim: The saved were initially too occupied with themselves to know others’ fate because that day brings immense preoccupation.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p236/r11.anchor: وأنهم ما شغلوا - مع كونهم من أهل السعادة - إلا لأن ذلك اليوم عظيم الشواغل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p398#2/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p398#2/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p398#2/r14.claim: The deniers turn away from the reminder despite the judgment and intercession just described awaiting them.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p398#2/r14.anchor: أي والحال المنتظرة هي هذه الموصوفة

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.claim: معرضين is a circumstantial accusative: the people are in a state of turning away, governed as قائما is in ما شأنك قائما; ما شأنك/مالك carries the sense ‘why?’.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.anchor: قال الله تعالى ^ ( فمالهم عن التذكرة

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.claim: In من ذا قائما بالباب, قائما is a circumstantial accusative; من is a subject built upon a noun, as in هذا عبد الله قائما and لمن الدار مفتوحا بابها.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.anchor: ومثل ذلك من ذا قائما بالباب على الحال أي من ذا الذي هو قائم

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.claim: Without pointing to an identifiable person, من ذا خير منك means ‘who is the one who is better than you,’ with خير منك in a relative-clause construction.

SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.claim: If the questioner points to someone whose superiority is evident, خير منك is accusative as a circumstantial phrase, like من ذا قائما.
SIBAWAYH:وذلك[قولك]ماشأنكقائماوماشأنزيدق.anchor: فإن أومأت إلى إنسان قد استبان لك فضله عليه فأردت أن يعلمكه

NAHHAS:v5p74/r2.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p74/r2.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p74/r2.claim: “Turning away” is in the accusative as a circumstantial expression.

SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r1.claim: معرضين is a circumstantial accusative from the pronoun in the prepositional predicate of ما; this is a so-called necessary circumstantial clause.
SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r1.anchor: حال من الضمير في الجار الواقع خبرا عن " ما " الاستفهامية

SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:74:49/r2.claim: عن التذكرة is governed by معرضين.

ASAD-NOTES:74:49#n28/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:74:49#n28/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:74:49#n28/r1.claim: Asad's question points to the many people who refuse to listen to the truth.
ASAD-NOTES:74:49#n28/r1.anchor: I.e., with so many people who refuse to listen to the truth.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p339/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p339/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p339/r1.claim: The preceding phrase describes them turning away while awaiting the situation just described.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p339/r1.anchor: وهي مواعظ القرآن التي تذكر الآخرة، معرضين: أي والحال المنتظرة هذه الموصوفة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r1.claim: The fa orders this denial of their baseless turning from the Qurʾān after describing reasons to accept and reflect on it in the preceding account.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r1.anchor: والفاء في قوله فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين لترتيب إنكار إعراضهم عن القرآن

ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r2.claim: “Turning away” is a circumstantial accusative linked to the pronoun in the prepositional predicate “for them”; “from” governs it, and its fronting gives emphasis and maintains the verse ending.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r2.anchor: ومعرضين حال لازمة من الضمير في الجار الواقع خبرا لما الاستفهامية أعني لهم وهي المقصودة من الكلام وعن متعلقة بها

ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r3.claim: “The reminder” may mean all admonition, but the following context favors the Qurʾān specifically; the noun literally means reminding and is applied emphatically to what is remembered.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p133#5/r3.anchor: وجوز أن يراد بالتذكرة ما يعم القرآن وما بعد يرجح الأول

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r1.anchor: {فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين} مواعظ القرآن {معرضين} نصب على الحال

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r2.claim: Muʿriḍīn is accusative circumstantially; another view means they became turned away.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p274/r2.anchor: {معرضين} نصب على الحال، وقيل صاروا معرضين.

DURR-FULL:v8p339/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p339/r1.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p339/r1.claim: Qatada identifies the reminder from which they turn away as the Qur'an.
DURR-FULL:v8p339/r1.anchor: عن قتادة {فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين} قال: عن القرآن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r2.claim: The next passage expresses amazement at their persistence in rejecting reminders, following the statement that the Qur’an is a reminder for humankind.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r2.anchor: تفريع للتعجيب من إصرارهم على الإعراض عن ما فيه تذكرة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r3.claim: The explicit noun “reminder,” rather than a pronoun, makes the rebuke cover their rejection of every reminder, especially the Qur’an.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r3.anchor: وجيء باسم التذكرة الظاهر دون أن يؤتى بضمير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r4.claim: “What is the matter with them?” is an interrogative used to express amazement at their strange state.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r4.anchor: استفهام مستعمل في التعجيب من غرابة حالهم بحيث تجدر أن يستفهم عنها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r5.claim: “To them” predicates the interrogative mā, with an understood “is established”; muʿriḍīn is a circumstantial clause for its pronoun, and “from the reminder” modifies it.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r1.claim: The people meant are Quraysh disbelievers, who turned from the Quran and its admonitions; by refusing belief, they have nothing for them in the afterlife.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r1.anchor: يعني كفار قريش حين نفروا من القرآن والتذكير بمواعظه والمعنى لا شيء لهم في الآخرة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r2.claim: Their flight from the Quran is compared with the donkeys in the following verse.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p412/r2.anchor: ثم شبههم في نفورهم عنه بالحمر فقال تعالى

JISHUMI:v10p7170/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r10.claim: معرضين is an accusative circumstantial expression (ḥāl).
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r10.anchor: معرضين نصب على الحال. إنه تذكرة الهاء كناية عن القرآن

JISHUMI:v10p7173/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r1.claim: The verse requires reflection on the signs and makes turning away a major sin deserving threat; people are blamed because rejection is their act.
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r1.anchor: على أشياء: منها: وجوب تدبر الآيات.

JISHUMI:v10p7173/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r2.claim: Asking what prevents belief denies compulsion theories that God creates rejection and removes capacity; the alleged obstacles contradict the verse and God's commands.
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r2.anchor: والعجب أنه تعالى يقول معجبا: ما الذي منعهم من الإيمان، وإنما أراد نفيا للمنع،

JISHUMI:v10p7173/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r3.claim: The author rejects that God creates rejection and inability to reflect, since the verse treats people as answerable agents.
JISHUMI:v10p7173/r3.anchor: منها: خلق الكفر والإعراض فيه. ومنها: القدرة الموجبة لها.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r1.claim: Al-tadhkira means reminder or admonition, referring either to the Qur’an or to other exhortations.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r1.anchor: عن التذكير وهو العظة ، يريد : القرآن أو غيره من المواعظ

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r2.claim: Muʿriḍīn is accusative as a circumstantial qualifier, as in the expression ‘what is the matter with you standing?’
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r2.anchor: نصب على الحال ، كقولك : مالك قائما

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r9.claim: Their avoidance of Qur’an and admonition is likened to startled wild asses bolting; the comparison plainly censures their foolishness and lack of sense, like the donkey carrying books.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r9.anchor: شبههم في إعراضهم عن القرآن واستماع الذكر والموعظة وشرادهم عنه ، بحمر جدت في نفارها مما أفزعها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet promises ten good deeds for each person in Mecca who believed in Muhammad or disbelieved in him to whoever recites al-Muddaththir; no grading is stated.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.anchor: من قرأ سورة المدثر أعطاه الله عشر حسنات بعدد من صدق بمحمد وكذب به بمكة

BURSEVI:v10p186/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p186/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p186/r7.claim: The question follows the dreadful fate of the deniers: with so many reasons to accept and take heed from the Quran, what could make them turn away without cause?
BURSEVI:v10p186/r7.anchor: الفاء لترتيب أنكال إعراضهم عن القرآن بغير سبب على ما قبلها من موجبت الإقبال عليه والاتعاظ به

BURSEVI:v10p186/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p186/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p186/r8.claim: Ma is interrogative, mu'ridin is a circumstantial accusative for the pronoun in the locative predicate, and ʿan is attached to it.
BURSEVI:v10p186/r8.anchor: ومعرضين حال من الضمير في الجار الوقع خبرا لما الاستفهامسية وعن متعلقة به

BURSEVI:v10p186/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p186/r9.speaker: كشف الأسرار
BURSEVI:v10p186/r9.claim: Kashf al-Asrar glosses the turning away as either denial or refusal to follow the reminder.
BURSEVI:v10p186/r9.anchor: وفي "كشف الأسرار" س ه رشسيدست ايشانراكه ازنين ندى روكردانيده انده يقال لإعراض يكون بالجحود

BURSEVI:v10p187/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187/r6.claim: Their rejection and flight from Quranic admonition resemble wild asses driven into frantic flight by what frightens them.
BURSEVI:v10p187/r6.anchor: شبهوا في أعراضهم عن القرآن واستماع ما فيه من المواعظ

BURSEVI:v10p187/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187/r7.claim: A Persian gloss says they flee from listening because they lack a listening ear and an awakened heart; Mathnawi verses likewise contrast them with the living message and its spiritual secret.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r1.claim: The reminder is admonition, namely the Qurʾān.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r1.anchor: عن التذكير وهو العظة أي القرآن

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r2.claim: “Turning away” is a circumstantial accusative describing the pronoun, as in “why are you standing?”
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#8/r2.anchor: مولين حال من الضمير نحو مالك قائما

QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r1.claim: The question asks why Mecca's people have turned away from the message brought to them.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r1.anchor: أي فما لأهل مكة قد أعرضوا وولوا عما جئتم به.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r2.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r2.claim: Muqatil says turning away from the Quran takes two forms: denying it, or failing to act on it.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r2.anchor: وفي تفسير مقاتل: الإعراض عن القرآن من وجهين: أحدهما الجحود والإنكار، والوجه الآخر ترك العمل بما فيه.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r3.claim: معرضين is an accusative circumstantial qualifier of the pronoun in لهم; the lām carries verbal force, licensing the circumstantial accusative.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:49-50/r3.anchor: و «معرضين» نصب على الحال من الهاء والميم في «لهم» وفي اللام معنى الفعل فانتصاب الحال على معنى الفعل.

RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r1.claim: The reminder they turn away from is admonition, whether the Qur'an or other exhortations.
RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r1.anchor: أي عن الذكر وهو العظة يريد القرآن أو غيره من المواعظ

RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r2.claim: “Turning away” is accusative as a circumstantial expression, like “what is the matter with you, standing?”
RAZI-FULL:v30p186#3/r2.anchor: ومعرضين نصب على الحال كقولهم مالك قائما

STUDYQURAN:74:49/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:49/r1.speaker: Q, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:74:49/r1.claim: The Reminder refers to the Quran.
STUDYQURAN:74:49/r1.anchor: Here the Reminder is a reference to the Quran (Q, Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:74:49/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:49/r2.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:74:49/r2.claim: People turn away from the Quran either by denying it or by failing to act according to it.
STUDYQURAN:74:49/r2.anchor: from which people turn away either by denying it or by not acting in accord with it (Q).

TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r1.claim: The polytheists turn away from God's reminder in the Qur'an, refusing to listen, take admonition, or reflect.
TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة، {فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين} [المدثر: 49] أي عن هذا القرآن

TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r2.claim: Qatada identifies the reminder as this Qur'an.
TAB-FULL:v23p454#2/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، {فما لهم عن التذكرة معرضين} [المدثر: 49] أي عن هذا القرآن

TABATABAI:74:49-52/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:49-52/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:49-52/r1.claim: After the preceding threat and promise, the passage presents as astonishing the rejection of the Qur'an's reminder and recoil from manifest truth: they should believe, yet seek individual revelation instead.
TABATABAI:74:49-52/r1.anchor: في معنى الاستنتاج مما تقدم من الوعيد والوعد أورد في صورة التعجب من إعراضهم عن تذكرة القرآن

TABATABAI:74:49-52/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:49-52/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:49-52/r2.claim: The question expresses astonishment; an understood predicate completes ma lahum as ma kana lahum, the circumstantial muʿriḍin describes the pronoun in lahum, and ʿan al-tadhkira depends on muʿriḍin.
TABATABAI:74:49-52/r2.anchor: و { معرضين } حال من ضمير { لهم }

TABRISI:74:49-56/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:49-56/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:49-56/r1.claim: The question asks why they turn away from the Qurʾan's admonitions; if they reject it, they have nothing awaiting them in the afterlife.
TABRISI:74:49-56/r1.anchor: أي أي شيء لهم ولم أعرضوا وتولوا عن القرآن فلم يؤمنوا به

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r1.claim: The people turning away from the Qur’an are the disbelievers of Quraysh.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r1.anchor: - قوله تعالى: {فما لهم}، يعني كفار قريش حين نفروا عن القرآن.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r2.claim: The reminder is the admonition contained in the Qur’an.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r2.anchor: {عن التذكرة}، أي عن التذكرة بمواعظ القرآن.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r3.claim: Muʿriḍīn is accusative as a circumstantial accusative: what reason have they while turning away?
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r3.anchor: {معرضين}، نصب على الحال (¬6)، أي: أي شيء لهم، وهم معرضون عن التذكرة.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r4.claim: By rejecting the Qur’an without believing, they have nothing for themselves in the afterlife.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p457/r4.anchor: والمعنى: لا شيء لهم في الآخرة إذ أعرضوا عن القرآن فلم يؤمنوا به.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r1.claim: The question asks why they turn away from the Prophet's admonition.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r1.anchor: ما لهم يعرضون عن تذكيرك إياهم

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r1.claim: The simile portrays the disbelievers' response to the Prophet and his message as abnormally thoughtless, foolish, coarse, and indecorous.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r1.anchor: Burada yapılan benzetme, inkârcıların peygamber ve onun mesajı karşısında gösterdikleri tepkinin normal bir insandan beklenmeyecek kadar bilinçsiz, ahmakça, kaba ve edep dışı olduğunu ortaya koymaktadır.
